visualReviewWarning.description: At narrowly touching source hair tips, re-extraction leaves tiny endpoint details of roughly 1–3 native pixels. They do not interrupt the major hair silhouette or read as a visible real-use defect. No material truncation or neighboring hair remnant remains.
visualReviewWarning.disposition: Accepted at native-size visual severity review; no further redraw required.
